user_reported_bug: Phase 2D exhaustive audit found source-parity gaps: Settings hub omitted/mislinked, Delete Account unreachable, and public driver profile page omitted so customers could not inspect bidding driver reputation.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused UI testing verified Settings hub/slugs, Delete Account end-to-end, profile link regressions, dashboards, and role redirect. Delete Account and Settings hub now work, but the public driver profile is still not public: unauthenticated /driver-profile/<valid driver id> stays on the route but renders 'Profile not found' because GET /api/users/<id>/profile returns 401 Missing token. Static review also found Customer JobDetail uses <Link> for bid-driver-link-* without importing Link, so jobs with bids can crash instead of linking to driver profiles.

critical.issue: Endpoint is protected by get_current_user and returns 401 Missing token when unauthenticated; the required public driver profile flow therefore cannot load for unauthenticated users.

ui_bugs.issue: Unauthenticated valid driver profile renders 'Profile not found' instead of dpp-header/dpp-stats with driver reputation.
Source uses <Link> for bid-driver-link-{id} but imports only useNavigate/useParams from react-router-dom; bid list rendering can fail when bids exist.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend route exists and does not auth-redirect, but API call fails unauthenticated and the page shows an error state rather than driver details.

action_items: Make GET /api/users/{user_id}/profile truly public or otherwise allow /driver-profile/:id to fetch reputation data without an authenticated session, then verify dpp-header and dpp-stats render unauthenticated.
Import Link in /app/frontend/src/pages/portal/customer/JobDetail.jsx before testing any live bid card link flow.
Retest /driver-profile/:id unauthenticated and a customer job with bids after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py line 585 defines public_profile(user_id, requester: dict = Depends(get_current_user)); this contradicts the required public unauthenticated profile behavior.
/app/frontend/src/pages/DriverProfilePublic.jsx catches the failed profile request and sets p=null, causing a misleading 'Profile not found' for auth failures.
/app/frontend/src/pages/portal/customer/JobDetail.jsx has <Link to={`/driver-profile/${b.driver_id}`}> but the react-router-dom import lacks Link.

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend-focused; one API auth check used as evidence)
success_rate.frontend: 6/8 focused checks passed; critical public driver profile flow failed

Public driver profile failed for valid seeded driver id 3506677b-2008-4708-8e3f-a1cee03a6926 while unauthenticated: UI showed 'Profile not found'; local API curl confirmed GET /api/users/<id>/profile returns 401 Missing token without auth and 200 with auth. Regression smoke passed for customer/driver/admin dashboards, customer cross-role /driver redirect to /customer, driver open-settings to /settings, and admin profile terms/help to /settings/terms and /settings/support.
rca_of_the_issue: The migration added the React route/page but wired it to an endpoint that still requires get_current_user, so unauthenticated users cannot retrieve driver reputation data. Additionally, the bid card link implementation added JSX Link usage without importing Link, leaving the customer bid-card entry point fragile.
